notes: Values come from the IngramSpark File Creation Guide dated 8.24.26, User Guide v3.3 (24 August 2026), the rate card effective 1 February 2026, and public pages and tools on ingramspark.com. The help centre could not be read.
A 30% wholesale discount is below every published minimum (40% US and Canada, 35% UK, EU and Australia). Confirm the minimum your account allows on the title setup page.
IngramSpark publishes no spine formula. Enter the spine width from its cover template generator for the exact page count and paper before exporting a cover.
The last page of the interior is used by the printer and must be blank.
Using KDP and IngramSpark for the same book is allowed only with KDP Expanded Distribution switched off.
Nothing official mentions Bengali. Print accepts any language whose fonts are embedded, but retailer metadata and ebook retailers are not confirmed.
Title setup is free and the 2026 rate card lists no revision fee.

_meta.note: Source value 0.125 in (3 mm). No bleed on the bind edge. Without bleed the PDF page is exactly the trim size. Trim tolerance is 1/16 in.

IngramSpark words the 0.5 in (13 mm) margin as a recommendation for all sides and publishes no gutter table by page count. It is applied here as the minimum so that files are always inside it. For thick books a larger gutter reads better; the KDP gutter table is a sensible guide.

Minimum 18 pages. The stored page count is always even and the last page is used by the printer for its barcode and production data, so it cannot carry content. The app ends the file with a blank page on an even count. Ingram documents describe this in two slightly different ways; this is the safe reading of both.

notes: Preferred standards are PDF/X-1a:2001 and PDF/X-3:2002. All fonts embedded. Single pages, no crop or registration marks, no spot colours, no ICC profiles.
Black and white interiors: greyscale images at 300 ppi, 1 bit line art at 600 ppi, text in 100% black.
Colour interiors and covers: CMYK, total ink coverage at most 240%.
Maximum file size 1.5 GB (the User Guide says 1.6 GB; the lower figure is used).

_meta.note: No official document states a PDF version number or an explicit rule to flatten transparency; PDF/X-1a forbids transparency in any case.

IngramSpark publishes no spine formula. The width must come from its cover template generator or spine calculator for the exact page count and paper. The published pages per inch figures are only minimums and the official calculator is not linear for 50lb papers. Spine safety margin is 0.0625 in for spines of 0.35 in or more and 0.03125 in for narrower spines.

barcode.note: A barcode is mandatory, in 100% black on a white box. Ingram's cover template carries one that may be moved inside the safe area of the back cover but not resized; leave a 1.75 x 1.0 in area if you supply none. Without a price the add-on is 90000. The template generator only offers USD, UK pound and CAD prices in the barcode, so an AUD book gets 90000.

notes: Bleed 0.125 in on all four sides. Keep type 0.25 in inside the trim (the template allows 0.125 in).
Rich black for large solid areas is C60 M40 Y40 K100. Text of 24 pt or smaller should be 100% black only.
No spine text on paperbacks under 48 pages.

_meta.note: Trim sizes and paper availability were decoded from the availability matrix of the File Creation Guide (dated 8.24.26), where cells are shaded rather than labelled. Custom trim sizes also exist. Lightning Source Australia cannot print every option (no large format groundwood paperback, no textured cloth).

5.5 x 8.5 in (case laminate, cloth, dust jacket)
6 x 9 in (case laminate, cloth, dust jacket)
6.14 x 9.21 in (case laminate, cloth, dust jacket)

_meta.note: IngramSpark publishes no spine formula. The width must come from its cover template generator or spine calculator for the exact page count and paper. The published pages per inch figures are only minimums and the official calculator is not linear for 50lb papers. Hardcover spines come in steps of 1/16 in starting at 0.25 in.

barcode.note: A barcode is mandatory, in 100% black on a white box. Ingram's cover template carries one that may be moved inside the safe area of the back cover but not resized; leave a 1.75 x 1.0 in area if you supply none. Without a price the add-on is 90000. The template generator only offers USD, UK pound and CAD prices in the barcode, so an AUD book gets 90000.

notes: Case laminate: 0.625 in (16 mm) wrap on every side and a 0.5 in (13 mm) hinge each side of the spine. The board is the trim width minus 0.185 in and the trim height plus 0.25 in.
Case laminate cover width = 0.625 + board width + 0.5 + spine + 0.5 + board width + 0.625 in. Height = 0.625 + board height + 0.625 in.
Dust jacket: 3.25 in flaps, a 0.25 in wrap strip between cover and flap, 0.125 in bleed. Each cover panel is the trim width plus 0.4375 in. Largest jacketed trim is 6.14 x 9.252 in.
Always build hardcover covers on the template Ingram generates for the exact page count.

_meta.note: The board size formula is printed in the File Creation Guide under custom trim sizes; the generated template is authoritative. The board is narrower than the trim width by 0.185 in (boardExtraWidthIn is negative) and the hinge is extra width between board and spine. Sizes worked out here are for layout; check them against the template before export.
Hardcover page limits follow the rate card. For 70lb white paper the live tool allows 900 pages but the documents say 840; 840 is used.
Ingram asks for a JPG cover in RGB. Its documents give conflicting pixel limits; check the current figure on the upload screen. 1600 x 2560 is used as a safe working size.

notes: EPUB 3 per the August 2026 documents (the web page still says EPUB 2 or 3). The cover is uploaded as a separate JPG.
Ebook compensation is 85% of the net revenue Ingram receives.
The ebook needs its own ISBN.

_meta.note: The help centre (help.ingramspark.com) could not be read, so detailed EPUB guidelines are not confirmed. Validation is treated as required because retailers reject invalid files.

marketplaces.label: Australia
marketplaces.note: Published minimum wholesale discount is 35% (30% is below every published minimum; confirm the real minimum on your title setup page). AUD list prices are entered without GST according to a 2022 Ingram blog post and the calculator arithmetic; no current document restates it.

marketplaces.label: United States
marketplaces.note: Published minimum wholesale discount is 40% for the United States and Canada. Canada is mentioned in blog posts but is not a market in the public calculator or on the rate card.

marketplaces.label: European Union
marketplaces.note: One euro price covers the European Union market. VAT varies by country.

_meta.note: Compensation per wholesale sale = list price x (1 - wholesale discount) - print cost - global distribution fee (1.875% of the list price, since 1 February 2026). Print cost = per page cost x pages + per cover cost, from the rate card effective 1 February 2026. "Small" (regular) means a trim width under 6.15 in. Cost keys ending in "@dust-jacket" are for jacketed hardcovers. The real minimum discount is whatever the title setup page shows.

ebook.freeNote: No official statement on free ebooks was found. Compensation is 85% of the net revenue Ingram receives from the retailer, which is much less than 85% of the list price.

_meta.note: The share is of net revenue, not of list price.

fees.label: File revision
fees.when: Announced as free from 1 January 2026; the User Guide still mentions revision charges.

_meta.note: Inferred from the December 2025 announcement and the 2026 rate card.

fees.label: Global distribution fee
fees.when: Percentage of the local list price, deducted from compensation on every wholesale sale.

paperback.note: No official language restriction for print was found. All fonts must be embedded. Digital cloth spine stamping is Latin characters only.

ebook.note: Not confirmed. Ebook retailers reached through Ingram may not support Bengali.

_meta.note: No official IngramSpark page mentions Bengali for metadata, print or ebook retailers.

notes: IngramSpark takes BISAC subject codes (up to three), a short and a long description, contributor biographies and keywords. Field limits are shown in the title setup screens.

_meta.note: Field limits were not confirmed from a public page.
